body.statement: The observed law \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\) identifies \(p_x\), \(f_x\), and \(q_x\) for every \(x\in\mathcal X\), and for every \(a\in I\) it identifies the causal curve by \(\mu(a)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}p_xq_x(a)/f_x(a)\).
body.justification: The theorem separates the qualitative causal identifying step from the quantitative band-width problem.
body.gap: Huang and Zhang identify the ADRF with a known error transform, while Capitao-Miniconi, Gassiat, and Lehéricy identify only an unmarked latent signal under blind replicates.
body.consumer: Applied analyses with replicate dietary or exposure measurements obtain a whole-curve causal target before inference is imposed.
